name: report-a-bug
description: A customer reports a defect. The worker asks which product, build and hosting, collects the contact details, and raises a Report a Bug ticket.

turns.say: The utilization report in EAPx Cloud is showing every session counted twice since the last update.

It's EAPx Cloud, hosted by EAP Expert, build date October 1. It affects all our case managers when they run the monthly report. I'm Priya Nair, priya.nair@harbourside-eap.example, Harbourside EAP. We're in Eastern time and afternoons suit us for a screen share.
That's everything I have. Please pass it to the team.
